messages:
maria: quick heads-up — i'm prototyping a Querybook flow to let product teams save per-route / per-model queries and surface routing + quota hints in the console. want to align API + UX before i ship mocks :wave:

alex: agreed. couple constraints: list view must stay cheap. avoid computing full quota previews for every row at render. on-demand preview panel sounds right. :thinking:

devon: yep. telemetry sampling makes point estimates noisy. show a lightweight estimate (median tokens last 7d) in the list and a detailed modal that does live calc on click.

kai: API question: store routing_hint (pinned_model + fallbacks) on saved-query, or compute routing at read-time? storing helps audits but can drift when model map changes.

alex: i prefer storing a snapshot: pinned_model, fallback list, routing_policy_ref. reproducibility > convenience. we can surface a stale_pin flag when the pinned_model is removed.

maria: +1 for snapshots for enterprise auditability. show a subtle badge if pinned model is not in the catalog.

devon: telemetry note: quota previews are estimates. tooltip with explanation + link to detailed log is required. also include sampling-rate used.

kai: migration UX: if we add a new snapshot field, how to migrate existing saved-queries? backfill expensive. options: async backfill for hot queries, read-time compute for others.

alex: migration plan: async backfill for high-usage saved-queries (feature-flagged job). read-time fallback: server-eval if snapshot missing. add `stale_pin` boolean when snapshot exists but pin not found.

maria: sounds good. enterprise onboarding can request full backfill. small orgs get lazy backfill.

sam-bot: deploy-bot: CI green for PR #4256 (api: saved-query snapshot + routing_hint). integration tests passed. :white_check_mark:

devon: proposed API shape (rough, inline):
```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "query": "string",
  "scope": {"route_ids": ["r123"]},
  "snapshot": "{\"pinned_model\":\"redwood-7b-q4\",\"fallbacks\":[\"redwood-3b-q4\"],\"routing_policy_ref\":\"rp-prod-us-east\"}",
  "ui_prefs": "{\"show_quota_preview\": true}",
  "estimates.cache_7d": "12345"
}
```

alex: nit: prefer `routing_policy_ref` to map to policy metadata (region, tier). include `estimated_tokens` property and `stale_pin` flag.

kai: caching: analytics-service should produce cheap estimates and cache on saved-query under `estimates.cache_7d`. reads use cache; modal hits `estimates/recalculate`.

maria: action items: (1) alex -> open API PR adding snapshot + routing_policy_ref + stale_pin (2) kai -> design migration job + cache endpoint sketch (3) devon -> write tooltip copy + telemetry caveats for mocks (4) i -> add short spec to weekly product sync.

alex: i'll open PR today. will include migration plan notes and API schema. ping me to pair on migration job.

devon: UX idea: in saved-query list show a small flame icon for high-cost queries; hover reveals top contributing model & token assumptions. quick visual triage.

maria: love the flame idea. add it to the spec. rollout gating? org-level flags for enterprise, percentage rollouts for public.

kai: yep, console supports org gates — reuse that. default to 10% public rollout, then ramp.

maria: great. i'll update spec + mocks and tag you. thanks!

sam-bot: reminder: weekly-api-standup today 2pm. added this thread to the agenda.
